justification: The drawdown-verify CI job pulls the official postgres:16 image from Docker Hub again instead of mirror.gcr.io; Docker Hub has pulled fine since the single timeout on 2026-10-10, per the user.

break_it.scenario: Docker Hub times out or rate limits the GitHub-hosted runner again

break_it.how: a failed service container pull fails the job; check_pr_gates.py refuses to merge on a failed run; the workflow comment names mirror.gcr.io as the tested fallback
break_it.repro: point image at a nonexistent tag and push

post_merge.manual_verify: the gates run on main after merge shows the drawdown-verify job green
